<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has confirmed that the meeting is booked for Thursday at 14:30. My final task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function.
- `day`: "Thu"
- `start`: "14:30"
- `body`: I will write a professional and concise email body.

After sending the email, the task will be complete, and I can end my session.
